{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjqe88AAAABZjK9VQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3INzhDJ6GI", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IN", "number": 117, "title": "Add an evidence-qualified general public bulletin-board reading and contribution journey", "body": "## Problem

At baseline `2c6f0df838fa84e98a2d43eb900c5ab0008f5ab8`, MAIN/index → `13 コミュニケーション` offers five SIG destinations. There is no separate general public bulletin board for notices, recruitment and practical exchanges. Wakaba serves beginners and does not supply this distinct service purpose.

This is an existing fidelity omission, not a demonstrated regression from the latest profile increment.

## Expected outcome

Provide one complete browser-local journey:

`MAIN or index → 13 → 6 一般掲示板 → 募集とお知らせ → LIST / READ / UNREAD / NEXT → WRITE or REPLY → review/edit/submit or cancel → BACK → communication directory → actual caller`

Preserve communication selectors 1–5. Selector 6 opens the single board directly; no additional directory is necessary. Reuse existing forum reading, composition, identity, calendar and transactional persistence behavior.

A pristine new world receives three short original Japanese contributions from at least two existing fictional residents: a hobby-circle recruitment notice, an explicitly linked response and a separate practical notice. Keep examples plausible for late 1996 without copying archival messages, identities or images. Existing and imported worlds receive no automatic examples; users can create the first contribution explicitly.

## Context

### Historical evidence and reconstruction judgment

Sources inspected live on 2026-10-24:

- [NEC-authored paper, April 1989](https://www.jstage.jst.go.jp/article/jjsei/5/1/5_KJ00002152638/_pdf/-char/ja), printed page 61, distinguishes general, themed and regional boards. It describes member contributions addressed to a broad readership, consisting of a title and body, with headings used to select messages. Its illustrated categories include recruitment. Confidence is high within that earlier configuration. The [publisher index](https://www.jstage.jst.go.jp/browse/jjsei/5/1/_contents/-char/ja) confirms April 1, 1989 and pages 60–64. PDF text contains OCR damage; original screen geometry was not authenticated.
- [NEC PC-VAN office account, March 1993](https://www.jstage.jst.go.jp/article/jkg/43/3/43_KJ00002959297/_pdf/-char/ja), printed page 232, separately describes bulletin boards for recruitment, questions and exchanges. High confidence for the documented earlier service purposes; continuity into late 1996 is an inference.
- [まいとーく client-author description](https://www.vector.co.jp/soft/win95/net/se024554.html) separately lists general/regional board unread retrieval and writing alongside SIG operations. Confidence is high in the stated capability, but its release history does not establish when every feature became available. Client automation does not authenticate host commands.
- [Paradise Army MAIN reproductions](https://paradisearmy.com/doujin/pasok3pc-van.htm) distinguish an older bulletin-board MAIN entry from the later communication grouping. The circa-1996 example supports retaining MAIN 13's label. These are retrospective reproductions, not authenticated captures, and supply no target-year secondary route.

Judgment: moderate confidence supports a small general-board experience in the fictional late-1996 setting. Selector 6, placement beneath communication, the board name, internal mapping, header layout, anonymous reading, reply behavior and all reused controls are category D reconstruction. Do not transplant the older MAIN selector or claim an authenticated jump command, complete directory or exact 1996 workflow.

Focused general/regional-board and target-year command searches recovered no qualifying late-1996 host sequence. Search-only modern summaries and earlier directory leads do not establish additional controls.

### Implementation and prior work

- `src/navigation.ts` owns communication selection, forum context, content refresh requirements and parent navigation. `src/forums.ts` resolves board mappings and renders lists, details, identities and reply references.
- `src/wakaba.ts`, its fixture, and Wakaba initialization provide a bounded precedent for an authored board outside the historical SIG directory. Use a distinct application key such as `LOCAL-BULLETIN:1`; any SIG-shaped storage container is an implementation convention. User-facing screens should identify a general bulletin board.
- `src/storage/repository.ts::createForumPost` can create missing directory/board records atomically during successful human submission. Reuse it without a schema migration or new persistence subsystem.
- `src/main.ts`, `src/connection.ts` and `src/commands.ts` already connect refreshed content, selected humans, read tracking and composition. Preserve those real callers and input ownership.
- Existing optional resident activity can discover stored forums. Preserve its consent, eligibility, privacy and budgets. A short notice-oriented culture may use the existing hook; do not add schedules, preferred-board changes, forced replies or a generation requirement.

Live repository searches returned no open Issues or PRs. Searches for bulletin/general-board terms found no equivalent handoff. Related [Issue #109](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/issues/109) covers Wakaba, and [Issue #107](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/issues/107) covers unread reading. Inventory and terminology-dependent searches have limits.

[PR #116](https://github.com/takahirox/pcvan/pull/116) reports final-revision results of 74 focused and 445 complete-suite passing checks with three workers. `docs/validation.md` records the earlier 73/444 implementation stage. These are Coordinator records, not checks performed by this research graph. Default/eight-worker reliability remains unresolved. This graph changed nothing and ran no application, build, tests, model download or inference.

Only this board is in scope. Regional directories, commerce, historical search/editor/paging controls, library editorial participation and other MAIN destinations remain deferred.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Add communication selector `6 一般掲示板`, opening `募集とお知らせ` from both MAIN and index routes. Preserve selectors 1–5, historical MAIN labels and existing jumps. HELP identifies available controls; BACK returns board → communication → actual caller, and MAIN clears the return stack. Re-entry retains no stale board context. Communication itself exposes no composition target.
- [ ] Reuse LIST, numbered READ, UNREAD, NEXT, WRITE and REPLY with existing identity/date rendering and same-board reply references. Anonymous visitors can list/read; personal unread tracking and submission retain existing HANDLE requirements. Empty or absent boards remain usable, while duplicate or inconsistent mappings fail closed without selecting arbitrary records.
- [ ] Preserve fresh selected-human/content reads, gapped numbering, monotonic per-human/forum markers and persistence-before-display behavior. Rapid NEXT commands must persist and display the same selected candidate. Marker or refresh failures must not reveal a newly selected body or reuse stale content.
- [ ] Insert the three authored examples only during pristine bootstrap, atomically with valid authors, reply references, provenance and existing calendar anchoring. Preserve every existing fixture. Reopen, reconnect, consent, legacy population, existing-world expansion, deletion and JSON restoration must not backfill examples or missing records. Confirmed world reset may recreate the pristine starter world.
- [ ] When the board is absent, only successful explicit submission may create its required container, forum and post. Browsing, registration cancellation, draft cancellation, invalid input and failed saving create none of those records. Preserve review/edit/retry behavior, transactional numbering, concurrent-tab allocation, cross-board reply rejection and rollback. Reload and backup/restore retain saved contributions without changing database or backup formats.
- [ ] Add focused controller, production-terminal and IndexedDB coverage using existing Playwright helpers and Wakaba precedents. Cover both entry parents, all three examples and their reply link, read/unread progression, new posting and replying, review/edit/cancel, empty restores, lazy creation, failed writes, concurrent numbering and duplicate mappings. Exercise current-name/literal markup rendering, terminal-log inclusion, Settings/About return and a 320px keyboard journey. Preserve composition/IME and restore/reset invalidation behavior.
- [ ] With background activity controlled, compare protected records before/after browsing, cancellation, reading and submission. Allow only intended board/post/read-marker changes and ordinary session bookkeeping. Preserve unrelated SIG/Wakaba records, private mail, conference/OLT state, consent, resident configuration and budgets. Anonymous/no-consent use must require no external requests or model loading. Reuse existing stubs; no real-model execution is required.
- [ ] Update README navigation/commands, existing historical research and on-demand About content with URLs, inspection date, era, confidence, original authorship and category D assumptions. Keep routine screens concise. Clearly distinguish the general board from SIGs and Wakaba; do not claim complete historical coverage or authenticated commands.
- [ ] The Coordinator runs focused new-board checks with relevant existing navigation, forum, Wakaba and composition coverage, then `npm test -- --workers=3`. The existing configuration performs TypeScript checking and production build. Preserve functional, storage/import/reset, consent, mail, OLT, IME and terminal regression assertions; change only legitimately affected counts or menu expectations. Review the final diff, documentation links and `git diff --check`, reporting actual failures, corrections and skipped checks. Three-worker success does not resolve default-worker reliability.

## Optional validation

Comparison with a subsequently recovered dated manual/session, former-user feedback, native Japanese IME and additional browser engines may supplement automated evidence. None is a completion gate; no hardware or subjective approval is required.

## Required post-merge verification

None required. The Coordinator can verify this journey and its safeguards against production assets before merge.
